note: Log and crash signatures. Each: id, match (regex, case-insensitive), log, meaning, fix, fact. F4SE statuses come from F4SE 0.7.9 PluginManager.cpp (fact f4se.loader_statuses).

signatures.meaning: the DLL in F4SE/Plugins exports no F4SEPlugin_Version: it is not an F4SE plugin, or it targets the pre-Next-Gen runtime
signatures.fix: remove it from Data/F4SE/Plugins or install the build for this runtime

signatures.match: incompatible with current version of the game
signatures.meaning: the plugin does not declare support for this runtime
signatures.fix: install the plugin version made for the installed runtime (f4forge game shows it)

signatures.match: address library needs to be updated
signatures.meaning: the Address Library bin for this runtime is missing or older than the plugin needs
signatures.fix: update Address Library for F4SE Plugins (nexus fallout4/mods/47327)

signatures.meaning: the plugin needs a newer F4SE than the installed one
the plugin's version data is malformed
signatures.fix: report it to the plugin author; remove the plugin

signatures.match: fatal error occurred while (loading plugin|checking plugin compatibility)
signatures.meaning: the plugin crashed during load or its compatibility check
signatures.fix: disable the plugin and check its own log

signatures.meaning: the plugin's own load function returned false
signatures.fix: read the plugin's log in My Games/Fallout4/F4SE

signatures.meaning: Windows could not load the DLL (a missing dependency or a wrong architecture)
signatures.fix: install the Visual C++ redistributable it needs, or the x64 build

signatures.meaning: the game read or wrote invalid memory; the modules and call stack below it name the suspects
signatures.fix: look at the first non-game module in the probable call stack and the recently changed mods; roll back the latest change

signatures.meaning: unbounded recursion (often a script or a bad precombine/previs chain)
signatures.fix: check the call stack for repeating frames

signatures.match: Dumping stack|Suspended stack count is over our warning threshold
signatures.meaning: the Papyrus VM is overloaded; scripts are backing up
signatures.fix: find the scripts named most often in the dump; remove polling loops

signatures.match: Cannot call \w+\(\) on a None object
signatures.meaning: a script used a property or variable that is not filled
signatures.fix: fill the property in the plugin (records show) or guard it with 'if x'
